scenarios.title: The table lists all eight placeholders, each with a command
scenarios.notes: Risk: a missing or misspelled row misleads every agent. Check each row of the table in _common.md. Run every branches.py name command in a scratch repo with sample ids and confirm exit 0 and a printed name. Confirm the argument names (--kind, --id, --area, --n) match what branches.py accepts.

scenarios.title: The slice branch row maps to the slice command
scenarios.notes: The row must hold branches.py name --kind slice --id <sliceId>. Run it in a scratch repo with a custom branchFormat and confirm it prints the formatted name.

scenarios.title: The run branch row follows the git mode
scenarios.notes: The row must name config.runBranch in stack mode and the last entry of branches.py list --kind run otherwise. Run list --kind run in a repo with several run branches and confirm the last entry is the newest. Try a repo with none.

scenarios.title: The verify branch row comes from the prompt input
scenarios.notes: The row must name the branch input. No text in _common.md may call branches.py name --kind verify. Also check that branches.py name refuses --kind verify or the section does not offer it.

scenarios.title: The section tells the reader to classify a branch with parse
scenarios.notes: Run branches.py parse --repo . --branch <name> on a loop branch, a foreign branch and hostile names from the attack corpus (flag-like, traversal, NUL, unicode). A foreign branch must print null. Hostile input must not crash or print a loop kind.

scenarios.title: The edited prompt keeps the STE style and the other prompts still match
scenarios.notes: Run ste-check.py on _common.md and confirm exit 0. Confirm the Long commands bullet and later bullets are unchanged and still parse as bullets.
